headline: Central Bank of Nigeria Data Localisation Deadline Pressures Banks and Fintechs
summary: Nigeria's financial services industry faces a major technology transition as the Central Bank of Nigeria enforces local storage and management of critical payment transaction data ahead of the January 1, 2027 deadline.
why: Data localization mandates require substantial IT infrastructure upgrades and operational adjustments for commercial banks and fintech operators within emerging African markets.

impacts.name: Nigerian Banking and Fintech Sector
impacts.why: Mandatory local data storage requirements impose compliance and infrastructure costs on local lenders and fintechs.
